metadata.fidelity: exact public Managed Agents session, primary-event-list, and aggregate-usage boundary; referenced remote agent owns roster, tools, and environment
metadata.local_limits_scope: max_model_calls and max_concurrency describe the one outer Scaffold Lab session call; max_depth, max_tool_calls, max_tool_output_bytes, and max_agent_turns do not constrain Managed server threads or tools
metadata.resource_limits_scope: local token and cost limits are post-session accounting gates; use --managed-budget-cents for the provider-side shared list-cost cap, which is enforced between model requests and may overshoot by the crossing request
metadata.accounting_scope: session aggregate tokens and public-list-price list_cost are authoritative; primary events are condensed and are not a complete child-thread trace or invoice record
metadata.trace_scope: capture_content is false, so artifacts retain event counts and local lifecycle summaries rather than raw primary provider events; enable content capture only on controlled non-sensitive tasks
metadata.reproducibility: release runs require --managed-agent-version plus a separately exported and hashed remote agent and environment definition; current artifacts do not persist that complete sanitized snapshot
